stanzas: Where every beginning was planted and grown
Keep heart and mind open and you’ll need no more
Magician, wizard, between worlds you stand
Where light meets darkness power takes of fiach dubh
Call the dark the wind beats start
To open my heart of fiach dubh
You return to light bring healing from the heart of
The night With love and humility face the void
Time destroyed The raven cries through the midnight air
The wings of creation carry my prayers
Flexible and deep meditation see through the eyes
Creatures answer the call of my hand
Old forests speak from the roots of the land
Serene I work in the fertile dark
I call the night dare the winds of creation
Oh Raven, carry me the one far away
When childhood pain asks to be released
The thinner it grows veil between worlds and the wisdom
Carry upward the dream and the plea
Through shadows you return to light
You bring healing from the heart of the night
Time destroyed The raven cries through the midnight air
The wings of creation carry my prayers
Guarding the truth and dark unseen
And carry my prayers through the dark of night
